TOP_added_fixed_capacitance_F.authoritative_metric: CDAC gain error from standalone fixture weights of the extracted view with its planned fill <= 4.7% (specs/arch.json error_budget.gain_error_allocation)
TOP_added_fixed_capacitance_F.basis: Screening proxy per side: GE ~= Cp/C_eff with C_eff ~= 1.22 pF (1.025 pF units plus extracted TOP-bottom coupling), so 4.7% ~= 57 fF of TOP capacitance to 0, VSS, VDD and fixed references. Prefill paired CDAC measures 38.5 fF, leaving about 19 fF for its planned fill. Top-level TOP wiring and comparator/sampler layout share 0.8% (~10 fF) separately.

TOP_differential_capacitance_imbalance_F.basis: Side gain mismatch <= ~0.1% of C_eff; it converts common-mode reference steps into differential error. Prefill paired CDAC measures 0.17 fF.

CDAC_systematic_linearity_LSB.basis: |DNL| and endpoint |INL| from gain-normalized extracted bit weights (specs/arch.json error_budget.layout_systematic_linearity_lsb); prefill paired CDAC 0.33/0.29, original layout 0.15/0.10

measured.method: standalone transient cdac-stacked-mx-20261118 of the merged extraction; the charge model gives the same values

comparator_input_route_capacitance_F.basis: Native comparator delay/load sweep required before detailed routing freeze

reference_gate_route_delay_s.basis: Measure actual gate transitions/establishment using the current single-edge D2 reference once its layout is drawn

sar_handshake_route_delay_s.basis: Close timing against actual per-bit conversion budget; no zero-delay substitution

migration_acceptance.geometry: same normalized GDS geometry and cell connectivity
migration_acceptance.drc: no new markers; preserve two original warnings
migration_acceptance.tt: same ten-frame fixture, compare code, event counts, sampling closes and conversion times
migration_acceptance.timing_tolerance_basis: one maximum saved/transient step of the unchanged short fixture; report actual differences

fill: Follow Layout/specs/fill-policy.md: retain required matching/device dummies in the core; manage density fill separately. Gain-sensitive modules (CDAC) own a deterministic in-footprint OD/PO plan aligned to the unit grid plus PDK fill-blocking layers over their sensitive conductors, and are qualified with that plan in place; the top level fills everywhere else and honors the blocks. Final qualification uses actual filled top DRC/LVS/PEX.
qualification: DRC execution, LVS, functionality, settling, parasitics and terminal reliability are separate verdicts.
